page.notFoundTitle: This player is no longer in the squad
page.notFoundBody: The player may have been removed from the team. The journey is no longer shown.
page.noTeamTitle: Your journey grows with your team
page.noTeamBody: Once your coach adds you to the team in Ndamba, your sessions, matches, the coach's observations and your objectives gather here, season after season.
page.linkTitle: Who are you in the team?
page.linkBody: Pick your name in the {{team}} squad to see your journey.
page.linkEmpty: The squad is still empty. Ask your coach to add the players.

hero.levelsNone: since the start of the season

stage.kid: Under 13: simple markers, never a ranking.
stage.teen: 13 to 16: progress and match markers, no ranking.
stage.kidPlayer: Every session counts. Here is what is moving forward.
stage.teenPlayer: What you have built, and the next step.
stage.adultPlayer: Your season in numbers and in progress.

ribbon.aria: The season at a glance: {{sessions}} sessions attended out of {{marked}}, {{matches}} matches played, {{obs}} observations, {{evals}} evaluations.

skills.title: Progress by competence
skills.hint: The Njangi Code grid (chapter 25), levels 1 to 4, since {{from}}. Tap a competence to see its curve.
skills.emptyCoach: No dated evaluation yet. Evaluate the ten competences: each evaluation keeps a record of the levels, and the curve takes shape over the season.
skills.emptyPlayer: Your coach has not evaluated your competences yet. From the first evaluation, your curve shows up here.
skills.chartAria: {{skill}}: levels {{points}}. {{plus}} strengths observed, {{work}} things to work on.
skills.topBody: This behaviour makes the difference and makes others play better. Now the job is to keep it under fatigue and pressure.
skills.evidenceNote: Below the curve: {{plus}} strengths (green) and {{work}} things to work on (clay), as evidence from play.

timeline.title: The journey, step by step
timeline.hintCoach: Everything that happened, most recent first: evaluations, observations, matches, sessions, objectives and milestones.
timeline.hintPlayer: Your story of the season, most recent first.
timeline.emptyCoach: Nothing yet for this season. Observe a session, take the register or evaluate the competences: the thread fills itself.
timeline.emptyPlayer: Nothing yet for this season. Your thread fills with your sessions, your matches and your coach's observations.
timeline.evalFirstBody: {{n}} competences rated on the 1 to 4 grid.
timeline.bench: On the bench, did not play

derived.first_matchAdult: First match on record in Ndamba, against {{opponent}}
derived.first_goalAdult: First goal on record in Ndamba, against {{opponent}}

objectives.title: Objectives for this cycle
objectives.hint: One to {{n}} objectives at a time, for six to eight weeks, then a review.
objectives.emptyCoach: No objective in progress. Pick one or two competences to work on during the cycle, as chapter 25 advises.
objectives.emptyPlayer: No objective in progress. Choose what you want to work on over the coming weeks.
objectives.subNoMatch: No match played since the start of the cycle yet
objectives.fullTitle: {{n}} objectives in progress is the maximum
objectives.fullBody: Review one of the current objectives first: three at a time is plenty to progress.
objectives.coachOnly: Your coach set this objective: you can see it here, and you will review it together.
objectives.subHint: At player level, we follow the tagged actions that feed this sub-index.

suggestSkillBase.scan: Check before every first touch, even under pressure
suggestSkillBase.controle: Open up with the first touch into free space
suggestSkillBase.passe: Pick the pass that serves the intention of the moment
suggestSkillBase.conduite: Carry with the head up to draw, then release
suggestSkillBase.appels: Make runs that free a teammate
suggestSkillBase.communication: Give short, useful information on every action
suggestSkillBase.protection: Keep the ball under pressure from two opponents
suggestSkillBase.contre-pression: Press within 5 seconds after every loss
suggestSkillBase.decision: Choose quickly and well, even when tired

suggestSub.progression: Play forward: one progressive pass or carry per possession
suggestSub.penetration: Get into the final third and the box on every good possession
suggestSub.fixation: Draw two opponents, then free a teammate or switch
suggestSub.reprise: Win the ball back within 5 seconds after a loss
suggestSub.controle: Keep the ball: complete at least 85 passes out of 100

objectives.cycleHint: A cycle lasts six to eight weeks.
objectives.reviewNotePh: What worked, what is left to do.
objectives.subActions: Related actions since the start: {{count}} (matches played: {{matches}})

milestones.title: Big moments
milestones.empty: Milestones come on their own: first match, first goal, a competence reaching a new level. Add call-ups, moves to an older age group or injuries too.

default.promotion: Moved up to the next age group

placeholder.callup: E.g. called up to the regional U15 camp
placeholder.promotion: E.g. moved up to the U15, or promoted to the first team
placeholder.captain: E.g. captain for the first time
placeholder.return: E.g. back in full team training

milestones.autoNote: The first match, first goal, first start and every competence reaching Secure or Benchmark are added on their own.

perf.title: Season performance
perf.hint: From the matches tagged live, per 90 minutes.
perf.youngHint: The actions that make the team play. No comparison with anyone else.
perf.empty: No match played this season yet.
perf.untagged: To see match actions, tag the matches live and assign the actions to players.
perf.shareProg: Share of the team's forward actions

evaluate.title: Evaluate {{name}}
evaluate.rule: Evaluate in play, over several sessions, and record what you saw, not what you hope for (The Njangi Code, chapter 25).
evaluate.since: Observations since the last evaluation, on {{date}}:
evaluate.noteHint: For a minor, share the profile with the player and the family, starting with the strengths.

observe.title: Observe
observe.subtitle: Pick one or several players, tap what you see, save. Every observation feeds their journey ({{team}}).
observe.noTeamBody: To observe, you need players. Create the team and add the squad, then come back here during the session.
observe.ratingHint: From 1, difficult, to 5, excellent. It stays in the journey, never in a ranking.
observe.notePh: What you saw, in one sentence.
observe.noDictation: Dictation not available in this browser
observe.dictationError: Dictation stopped. Check microphone access, or type the note.
observe.pickFirst: Pick one or several players first.
observe.addSomething: {{names}}: tap a competence, a marker, a rating, or write.
observe.tipBody: Watch one player at a time for 8 to 10 minutes, in a small-sided game or a match, and note only what the situation showed. Several observations over several sessions make a fair evaluation.

feed.empty: No observation yet. The first one takes three taps.

tags.react-loss: Reacts at once to the loss

attendance.title: Take the register
attendance.hint: {{title}}, {{date}}. Tap a player to mark present, tap again for absent. The menu gives the details.
attendance.note: Every change is saved at once and feeds each player's journey.

minutes.title: Playing time
minutes.hint: Minutes played by each player ({{n}} minutes in all). Without an entry, a starter counts the whole match and a substitute zero.
